text: S588 runs one controlled CLO round trip on a geometry-identical Polo M diagnostic derivative to test whether registered-app XDATA IDs survive. The data is InfiniDrip-specific, not apparel-standard semantics. Keep files in C:\G04-CLO-DXF-Exchange\S588-xdata-retention-pilot, use the existing app session, and stop after the first measured result. The five Polo CUT failures and all other V03 gates remain held.
